sloka: स तु तत्रावसत्प्रीतो धर्मात्मा नैर्ऋतर्षभः ।समुद्रपरिघायां तु लङ्कायां विश्रवात्मजः ।। ७.३.३४ ॥
transliteration: sa tu tatrāvasatprīto dharmātmā nairṛtarṣabhaḥ ।samudraparighāyāṁ tu laṅkāyāṁ viśravātmajaḥ ।। 7.3.34 ॥

translations.english: That righteous soul, the chief of Rakshasas and son of Vishrava (Kubera), happily dwelt there in Lanka, which was surrounded by the ocean.
